title: Milo (FCP 2026)
synopsis: After leaving prison, Alice starts working as a waitress in a small cafeteria next to an auto repair garage. She befriends a young man named Milo, who works at the garage. Alice’s real reason for getting close to him is deeply personal: Milo is her son.

synopsis_lang.en: After leaving prison, Alice starts working as a waitress in a small cafeteria next to an auto repair garage. She befriends a young man named Milo, who works at the garage. Alice’s real reason for getting close to him is deeply personal: Milo is her son.
